summary.intent: Create a PR and resolve all open review comments from automated reviewers (CodeRabbit, GitHub Copilot) on PR #470 in the cipher-box repository.
summary.outcome: PR #470 was created and a valid review comment was addressed: the optional timeout in test-cross-client-sync.sh was scoped to macOS only instead of all platforms. The fix was committed and pushed.

repo: cipher-box uses pnpm for package management and has typecheck, test, and E2E test commands
E2E tests live in tests/e2e and desktop E2E scripts in tests/desktop-e2e/scripts/
PR workflow uses GitHub CLI (gh) for both REST and GraphQL operations

code.finding: An optional timeout parameter was being applied unconditionally across all platforms; it should only apply on macOS (platform-specific behavior)

workflow: Review threads can be fetched and resolved via GitHub GraphQL API using reviewThreads query with isResolved filter
Replying to review comments requires REST API with --field in_reply_to as integer (not -f flag)
Resolving threads uses GraphQL resolveReviewThread mutation
